title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 64-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well today and denies any recent symptoms such as swelling, fatigue, or changes in urinary output. He is adherent to his current medications and reports a stable diet. His laboratory work from last month shows a stable glomerular filtration rate.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Atorvastatin 40mg daily.

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Heart and lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema is noted. Skin is warm and dry.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 2. The patient's renal function remains stable at this time.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Order repeat metabolic panel and serum creatinine in three months to monitor renal function.
3. Patient instructed to maintain a low-sodium diet and follow up in the clinic as scheduled.
